headline: A 2014 law names the Chadron, Nebraska post office the Sergeant Cory Mracek Memorial Post Office.
what_it_does: This law renames a United States Postal Service building at 278 Main Street in Chadron, Nebraska. The new name honors Sergeant Cory Mracek. It does not change how the post office operates or what services it offers.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on November 26, 2014, and the renaming took effect on that date.
